item.title: ‘Frozen 3’ Stars Kristen Bell, Idina Menzel & Josh Gad Tease New Music at D23
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome back to Trending on Billboard, I'm your host. Today, we've got some exciting news for all you Frozen fans out there. The third installment of Disney's blockbuster franchise is officially underway, and we've got the scoop on what's to come."
[Short music transition]
Host: "At the recent D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event in Anaheim, California, stars Kristen Bell, Idina Menzel, and Josh Gad reunited onstage to tease new music ahead of the animated film's 2027 theatrical release. The trio even performed a few songs, including a rendition of 'Frozen Heart' and a new Olaf love song called 'Ooooh, Samantha'."
[Short music clip of "Frozen Heart" plays]
Host: "But that's not all - the stars also gave us a sneak peek at the story for Frozen 3. It looks like Anna will finally be tying the knot with Kristoff, and love is in the air for everyone... even Olaf? The film's directors, Jennifer Lee and Trent Correy, will be bringing this new story to life, with Oscar-winning songwriters Kristen Anderson-Lopez and Robert Lopez returning to write new music for the film."
[Short music transition]
Host: "The first two Frozen films have been massive hits, grossing over $1.28 billion and $1.45 billion worldwide, respectively. And let's not forget the soundtracks - the original Frozen soundtrack reached number one on the Billboard 200 chart in 2014 and spent 13 weeks at the top. We can't wait to see what Frozen 3 has in store for us. Mark your calendars for November 24, 2027, when the film hits theaters."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for today's episode of Trending on Billboard. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next one!"
